thread:
arjun: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC rename of the scim-service role the Okta SCIM connector started failing for a subset of orgs. Getting KMS decrypt errors + 422s from IdP. cc @marta @sam

marta: Ugh. Any raw error lines or example affected user?

arjun: Pasting a trimmed log and the SCIM payload we sent (sensitive fields redacted):

LOG: 2026-03-20T22:03:12Z scim-provisioner ERROR provisioner.go:412 "kms: decrypt failed" err="envelope header mismatch for alias=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scim/cryptoKeys/scim-prod-v2"
LOG: 2026-03-20T22:03:12Z scim-provisioner WARN webhook.go:88 "scim 422 response" idp_response="invalid externalId"

SCIM PATCH payload (trimmed): {schemas:["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],Operations:[{op:"replace",value:{externalId:"service:123",displayName:"ACME Corp - svc"}}]}

Previously externalId was generated as `svc_123` (underscore). The RBAC rename PR (#4823) changed the generator to emit `service:123` (colon). Looks like some orgs still have records keyed by the old extid. When the SCIM connector tried to encrypt the envelope for the new payload, KMS rejected due to envelope context mismatch (we put extid into the AAD envelope context).

sec-bot: ALERT [KMS] key alias rotation detected for alias=scim-prod-v2 at 2026-03-20T03:14:22Z — rotation_user=infra-bot — linked_incident=none

sam: Two moving parts here — (1) externalId encoding changed, (2) KMS envelope context includes extid -> decrypt fails when consumer expects old context. Quick triage:
- Confirm whether KMS envelope context uses `externalId`
- Check if key alias rotation happened around the same time (sec-bot just flagged it)
- Short-term workaround: have SCIM connector re-use legacy envelope context while we backfill extids

marta: Is the failure only for updates or also for initial provisioning?

arjun: Mostly updates / PATCH. New users create fine (they get new envelope context). But updates to existing resources are failing because IdP tries idempotent decryption using stored envelope context that doesn't match new one. Affected customers: 6 orgs, ~24 users.

sam: Steps I would run: curl to internal-kms decrypt with envelopeContext extid=svc_123 then with extid=service:123. If first works and second fails, confirms mismatch. Also check audit log: gcloud kms keys get-rotation-schedule and Cloud Audit logs around alias change.

arjun: Ran the decrypt simulation — first command returns plaintext, second returns InvalidEnvelopeContext. So confirmed. The alias rotation happened 2026-03-20 03:14 UTC (infra change). PR #4823 merged 2026-03-20 04:40 UTC. Bad timing.

marta: Ok. We should avoid changing externalId encoding without a migration. Immediate remediation options: backfill existing IdP records with new extid as secondary attribute; or make SCIM connector accept both envelope contexts for a reconciliation window; or roll back PR generator and run backfill later.

sam: Prefer connector dual-decrypt for 24-48h while reconcile job maps old->new extids. Code change: decryptTry(envelopeCtxNew) || decryptTry(envelopeCtxLegacy). Add structured audit event when legacy context used.

arjun: Implemented connector dual-decrypt in staging and ran reconcile for one customer — fixes their failing updates. Will push to prod with feature flag and run full backfill tonight. Creating incident INC-2026-1458 and a runbook note.

marta: Add follow-ups in postmortem: (1) integration test covering externalId generator changes, (2) do not put volatile attributes (derived from RBAC names) into KMS envelope context, (3) add playbook for key alias rotation impact.

sec-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1458 - "Okta SCIM updates failing after extid encoding change + KMS envelope context mismatch". Severity: P2. Notified oncall and SOC.

eve: Quick question — do we need to rotate keys again after backfill?

sam: Not immediately. After backfill + reconciliation and ensuring no leftover records reference only legacy extid, we can schedule a controlled key rotation. Add canary rotation in staging and verify decrypts for both contexts are not required.

arjun: Final status: feature-flagged dual-decrypt deployed at 2026-03-21T01:12Z, backfill completed for 24 users, SCIM retries cleared. Will follow up with a short postmortem and add unit/integration tests and the playbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks for the quick triage. Please link the postmortem when created and add the PR numbers for the dual-decrypt and the revert plan.

sec-bot: Audit note created and attached to INC-2026-1458.
